sections.overview: This small carnivorous marsupial is endemic to Queensland.
sections.identification: The recovery materials consulted do not provide a concise field diagnosis.
sections.habitat: It lives in cracking-clay Mitchell grass downs of north-west Queensland.
sections.diet: It is carnivorous; the recovery plan lists no prey.
sections.behavior: It uses soil cracks when dry and vegetation after rain.
sections.reproduction: The sources consulted do not specify breeding.
sections.ecology: It shares the genus Sminthopsis with the Kakadu dunnart S. bindi; see that profile.
sections.conservation: It is listed as Endangered in Australia and Queensland; threats include cats, grazing and prickly acacia.
